# Reference: Critique lenses

## Simple detection

| Detection | Suggested lenses |
|---|---|
| `.md` | clarity, coherence, audience fit, redundancies |
| `.vue` `.ts` `.js` `.py` | security, technical debt, readability, testability, coupling |
| `.json` | structure, key consistency, missing values |
| `archi` in the name | single point of failure, scalability, cost, operational complexity |
| `spec` in the name | clarity of acceptance criteria, forgotten edge cases, ambiguities |
| `brief` in the name | unclear scope, implicit assumptions, unaddressed open questions |

## Available lenses

- clarity
- coherence
- audience fit
- redundancies
- security
- technical debt
- readability
- testability
- coupling
- single point of failure
- scalability
- cost
- operational complexity
- edge cases
- ambiguities
- implicit assumptions
- unaddressed open questions

## Short definitions

- clarity: is the message understood immediately?
- coherence: is there any internal contradiction?
- audience fit: are the level and tone appropriate?
- redundancies: is there any needless repetition?
- security: does it expose risks or data?
- technical debt: rigidity, duplication, cost of change?
- readability: does the whole remain easy to read?
- testability: can the behavior be verified without friction?
- coupling: are the blocks too tightly dependent on each other?
- single point of failure: can a single element block everything?
- scalability: what happens at larger scale?
- cost: are the cost of ownership and the cost of change under control?
- operational complexity: is it too heavy to operate?
- edge cases: are there forgotten edge cases?
- ambiguities: can it be interpreted in more than one way?
- implicit assumptions: are there suppositions left unstated?
- unaddressed open questions: are critical decisions still unclear?
